facts.fact: ONECI, the Office national de l'etat civil et de l'identification, runs both civil status and identification, and its director general said on 16 September 2025 that its digital civil-status server is linked to the Registre national des personnes physiques.

systems.platform: digital civil-status system linked to a national server
systems.tiers: civil-status centres, national server, Registre national des personnes physiques
